thread:
Maya: Quick sync on the authz postmortem action tracker. Wanted to confirm owners and dates before we close the loop.
Liam: go for it. i've got bandwidth for the CI/integration pieces.
Maya: here are the items i sketched: 
- replace custom token parser with upstream lib + add fuzz tests (owner: Liam, ETA: 10 business days)
- tighten service account perms + update least-privilege matrix (owner: Priya, ETA: 7 business days)
- missing audit payloads fix + schema validation in collectors (owner: Carlos, ETA: 5 business days)
- secrets rotation playbook + automated roll lambda (owner: Ops, ETA: 15 business days)

Priya: noted. i'll need the current permission map export to start, can someone attach it?
Carlos: i pulled a quick list of endpoints w/ missing payloads earlier, saving to: https://s3.company/internal/audit/gaps-2025-06-20.csv
Maya: perfect. Priya, use that to focus service-by-service perms.
Liam: starting the lib bump tomorrow. question: do we adopt `oauth-token-tools` v2.1 or wait for v2.2 with the expiry fix?
Maya: prefer v2.1 now and add a compatibility shim; we'll upgrade to v2.2 when it's out. Add a note in the PR.
Liam: cool. adding CI commands to run fuzz harness:

```
./tools/fuzz_runner --target auth_token --iterations 5000
pytest tests/e2e/token_fuzz_test.py
```

OpsBot: Creating remediation epic and tickets... Epic REDW-8901 created. Tickets: REDW-8902 (token-lib), REDW-8903 (perm-matrix), REDW-8904 (audit-fix), REDW-8905 (rotation-playbook).
Maya: thanks OpsBot. can we attach owners + add the sprint tag `postmortem-remed-2025-s1`?
OpsBot: Sprint tag added.
Priya: quick Q on retention: are we standardizing all service audit logs to 180 days? seems heavy for some infra services.
Carlos: proposal: 180d for customer-affecting services, 90d for infra-only. i'll document the list.
Maya: agree with Carlos. Priya: update the matrix accordingly and add it to the runbook.
Liam: PR: https://github.com/redwood/token-tools/pull/312 - draft includes shim. tests flaky locally, digging in.
Priya: i'm starting perms exports now. will drop CSV into the epic and ping.
Carlos: plan for collectors: add JSON schema check in the pipeline and fail fast. snippet for template: 

```
{"type": "object", "properties": {"request_id": {"type": "string"}, "user": {"type": "object"}}}
```

Maya: solid. remember to include an alert for repeated missing fields (freq > 5 in 1h).
Carlos: added alert: `audit:missing_fields:high` -> pager to eng-oncall after 3 occurrences.
OpsBot: rotation-playbook template pushed: https://git.company/ops/rotation-playbook/-/blob/main/playbook.md
Maya: final check: recurrence analysis is overdue. i can own a 6-week lookback to surface patterns and file follow-ups. owner: Maya (ETA 4 business days).
Liam: i'll pair on the e2e tests with Priya for perms changes.
Priya: will update REDW-8903 with initial matrix and mark blockers if needed.
Maya: action recap: Liam -> token lib + fuzz tests (10bd), Priya -> perm matrix + perms changes (7bd), Carlos -> audit schema + retention list (5bd), Ops -> rotation playbook + lambda template (15bd), Maya -> recurrence analysis (4bd). keep the epic updated and bump priorities if anything slips. :thumbsup:
Carlos: added a note about targeting token-service first since it's highest incidence in the heatmap.
Liam: CI green on PR after a minor fix, moving to review.
Priya: matrix uploaded, linking in REDW-8903.
Maya: thanks team. closing this thread; we'll use the Friday 9am sync for status and blockers. if urgent, @here on eng-security channel.
